rules: Maintain layered architecture enforced by pyproject.toml and tests/test_architecture.py; storage owns filesystem interpretation, core owns pure identity policy, application uses typed ports.

modules.responsibility: Prepare immutable native datasets from parsed rows.
modules.interface: CSV snapshot and format produce cleaned dataset files; BOM headers share lexical policy.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Reads source CSV/images and writes contained prepared dataset files.

modules.responsibility: Own versioned cache identity and atomic reuse.
modules.interface: CSV bytes, ordered resolved references, format and version select one entry; hits avoid image-content/mtime reads and conversion.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Reads CSV/cache metadata, owns process locks and atomic cache publication.

modules.responsibility: Validate lexical annotation records and media geometry.
modules.interface: CSV rows produce ImageRecord values; literal labels and source-relative paths survive, invalid headers/rows fail with source context.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Reads CSV and source images for preparation; path resolution belongs here/storage helpers.

modules.responsibility: Centralize detection parsing and source-relative media resolution while retaining generic IO.
modules.interface: read_detection_csv preserves identity strings/empty cells/exact floats; read_ground_truth returns aligned source/execution views; resolved references consume captured CSV bytes.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Filesystem reads/writes and path resolution; no evaluation or model SDK calls.

modules.interface: CSV rows retain original strings and strict width/header diagnostics; BOM/media resolution agree with storage policy.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Reads publication CSV/media metadata without training preparation.

modules.responsibility: Infer or reload current-split predictions under canonical naming.
modules.interface: Resolved execution truth and checkpoint/settings produce predictions and inference evidence; incompatible naming fails before cache/model use.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Owns YOLO inference and prediction-cache reads/writes through permitted storage helpers.

modules.responsibility: Own prediction provenance and canonical publication bundles.
modules.interface: Prediction hashes bind name/stem/path mode; raw media association preserves lexical names/source IDs and not_evaluated status; mismatches fail.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Reads/writes local sidecars/result CSVs and publishes through ClearML ownership boundaries.

modules.responsibility: Adapt pinned scientific evaluation with pure identity admission.
modules.interface: Canonical member predictions produce unchanged calibration/AP/matches; unknown identifiers fail before filtering/scoring.
allowed_dependencies: only exact SDK ownership and peer edges in pyproject.toml/tests/architecture_helpers.py
forbidden_dependencies: application use cases/evaluation orchestration and entrypoints
unapproved peer adapters or SDK owners
modules.effects: Existing scientific adapter calls; no rendering/tracking/storage effects added.

modules.responsibility: Define project-owned source/execution records and comparison configuration.
modules.interface: GroundTruthRead holds row-aligned DataFrames supplied by storage; comparison InferenceConfig/SettledInference admit only name.
allowed_dependencies: application contracts/ports and inward workflow helpers

modules.responsibility: Declare typed storage and tracking interfaces for workflows.
modules.interface: Adds source/execution and detection reads plus naming-mode provenance operations; adapter details remain hidden.
allowed_dependencies: application contracts/ports and inward workflow helpers
modules.effects: None; protocols declare effects implemented by outer adapters.

modules.responsibility: Coordinate prediction using resolved media while publishing source rows.
modules.interface: CSV and checkpoint become raw predictions/provenance; standalone name/stem/path exports preserve source lineage.
allowed_dependencies: application contracts/ports and inward workflow helpers

modules.responsibility: Coordinate same-current-split model comparison and cache reuse.
modules.interface: Lexical truth remains publication evidence; resolved execution truth drives inference/fingerprints; naming and membership fail before scoring.
allowed_dependencies: application contracts/ports and inward workflow helpers

modules.responsibility: Calibrate and evaluate canonical CSV predictions with frozen thresholds.
modules.interface: Literal detection rows and hash-bound mode are checked before preparation/calibration; unknown identities or missing calibration split fail.
allowed_dependencies: application contracts/ports and inward workflow helpers

modules.responsibility: Validate pure canonical naming and membership policy.
modules.interface: DataFrames and optional mode produce validation or explicit ValueError; historical absent mode still requires membership.
allowed_dependencies: approved scientific stack and standard-library value operations
modules.effects: None; pure pandas/value operations, no path resolution or filesystem access.

modules.responsibility: Bind concrete adapters into explicit workflow dependencies.
modules.interface: New storage/provenance operations populate existing typed ports; callers do not construct adapters.
modules.effects: Composition owns adapter construction; execution remains at explicit workflow invocation.

modules.interface: Hydra requests with comparison stem/path fail clearly; standalone raw prediction modes remain supported.
modules.effects: Existing preflight only; new naming policy is pure.

contracts.rules: Layer isolation and adapter peer allowances remain unchanged.
Exhaustive layers, effect ownership, inert initialization and SDK/peer isolation with negative fixtures; no contract is weakened.

checks.expectation: All existing import contracts pass without weakening boundaries.
Reproduced input defects fail before corrections and pass after; unaffected cases retain results.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest tests/test_architecture.py tests/test_tooling_boundaries.py tests/test_check_docs.py -q
checks.expectation: Runtime graph passes and negative fixtures reject prohibited effects, aliases and targets.

documentation: docs/input-provenance.md owns input semantics; README/TECH_DETAILS, feature 008, CLI/publication contracts, end-to-end prerequisites and companion portable usage source link/reconcile those semantics. Parent dated evidence covers actual docs/native/package/review results.

review.reconciliation: Fresh independent read-only review of the integrated task-owned runtime/tooling/tests/docs and architecture scope after parent verification. All initial findings corrected and re-reviewed; actual added/modified paths covered, no moved/deleted runtime modules. Original local uv.sources overrides and untracked grid-search draft excluded. Native/package runtime manifests still match all180files; final review records preserve limits.
